description: Defines the 'ue_channel_state_manager' class which manages channel state information received from UEs, including CSI reports, SRS channel matrices, and related parameters for scheduling and precoding in a 5G NR context.

classes.name: ue_channel_state_manager
classes.description: Manages channel state information for a UE, including CSI reports, SRS channel matrices, and scheduling parameters.

methods.name: ue_channel_state_manager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with configuration and number of downlink ports.

methods.name: get_latest_csi_report
methods.description: Returns the most recent CSI report received from the UE.

methods.name: get_latest_tpmi_select_info
methods.description: Returns the latest PUSCH TPMI selection info.

methods.name: update_pusch_snr
methods.description: Updates the estimated PUSCH SNR in dB.

methods.name: get_pusch_snr
methods.description: Returns the current PUSCH SNR in dB.

methods.name: get_pusch_average_sinr
methods.description: Returns the average PUSCH SINR in dB.

methods.name: get_nof_dl_layers
methods.description: Returns the number of recommended downlink layers.

methods.name: get_nof_ul_layers
methods.description: Returns the number of recommended uplink layers.

methods.name: get_recommended_pusch_tpmi
methods.description: Returns the recommended TPMI for a given number of layers.

methods.name: get_precoding
methods.description: Fetches the precoding info based on chosen layers and resource blocks.

methods.name: handle_csi_report
methods.description: Processes a new CSI report from the UE.

methods.name: update_srs_channel_matrix
methods.description: Updates the SRS channel matrix information.

methods.name: is_aperiodic_csi_allowed
methods.description: Checks if an aperiodic CSI report can be scheduled in a given slot.

methods.name: on_scheduled_aperiodic_csi_pusch
methods.description: Records the slot of the latest scheduled aperiodic CSI report.

methods.name: on_scheduled_aperiodic_srs
methods.description: Records the slot of the latest scheduled aperiodic SRS report.
